solutions.title: Iterative sign stack
solutions.strategy: Track the current result and sign, pushing the outer result/sign when a parenthesized group begins.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each character is read once, and each parenthesis causes O(1) stack work.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The stack stores two integers per active parenthesis depth d.

solutions.title: Recursive expression parser
solutions.strategy: Parse an expression until a closing parenthesis and recursively evaluate parenthesized groups.

timeComplexity.explanation: The shared index advances through each character once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Recursive calls follow parenthesis nesting depth d.
